skills.name: You Little Insect
skills.description: Turns into a dark knight and gives axe attack. Bad effects on enemies.  *Advance  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *ATK x 3000% Area Damage  *Stuns enemies (4 sec)

skills.name: Love For The Master
skills.description: Takes out an Ainz body pillow and hugs it. Good effects on allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (4 sec) *HP x 60% Area Recovery (per sec) (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Overlord
abilities.description: Overlord Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Silence: Agility
abilities.description: Has a high chance of making all Agility type enemies' Skills unusable and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
